items.title: [2026-06-20] QckServe Store monsoon (Image Prompt)
items.content:
QckServe Store — Monsoon poster (4:5 social).

SCENE: A bright local shop doorway in a UP market street (Kanpur/Lucknow feel) during early monsoon — wet pavement, soft rain, warm shop light spilling out.
SUBJECT/POSE: A confident small-shop owner (30s, kurta) standing in the doorway holding a smartphone, looking up from it toward the viewer with a warm half-smile; a customer with an umbrella approaches.
PHONE UI MOCKUP: On the phone screen, a clean QckServe Store listing card — product tile, bold '₹0 to list' badge, '0% commission' chip, an orange 'Open Store' button. Crisp, legible, flat UI (no gradients).
COLOUR SYSTEM: dark base #1A1A1A, primary orange #ef6723, accent #FF6B00, deep burnt #a43d00, neutral off-white #F5F5F5. Flat solid blocks only — absolutely no gradients.
LIGHTING: warm key from shop interior, cool rainy ambient outside, gentle rim light on the subject from a passing streetlamp; soft reflections on wet ground.
TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY: oversized condensed bold headline 'MONSOON IS HERE', italic-serif accent 'your shop goes online', hero '₹0 / 0% commission', small wordmark 'qckserve.in/store'. Poppins-style for sans, contrast serif italic for the accent line.
EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → headline → phone screen → ₹0 hero → wordmark/CTA bottom-left.
CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, subject sharp, rainy street softly bokeh'd.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping high contrast, single clear value prop (free + zero commission), readable at small size.
LAYOUT: RESERVE the TOP-LEFT ~140px square logo zone empty — logo placed manually (do not generate a logo).
